summary:
Complete updated source code for CrediTrack incorporating:
1. Neon Style Manual Sync Button: Positioned intuitively at the top header of the main dashboard screen with striking neon blue border, subtle pulse animation, and vibrant outer glow effect.
2. Logic Retention & Auto-Load: Retains background sync while ensuring the manual button triggers an immediate, explicit API call to read/write and sync all card contexts and transaction history with the "CrediTrack_Card_Manager" Google Sheet on Google Drive.
3. Chronological sorting: All loaded and synced transactions remain strictly sorted chronologically by date with recalculated running balances.
4. Transparent/hollow neon chart bars: Complete implementation of empty bar fills with glowing neon borders (neon red for expense, neon yellow for interest, neon green for payment).
